typography.headings: Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel, or Marcellus (Serif, Elegant, Display)
typography.body: Lora, Merriweather, or Noto Serif (Clean, legible Serif/Humanist sans, NO Inter/Roboto)
typography.sanskrit: Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit or Noto Serif Devanagari (Must be used for all Shloka/Mantra text)
typography.instructions: Import Google Fonts for the chosen families. Use font-serif for all main titles, section headers, and deity names. Use devanagari font explicitly for shlokas. Do not use generic fonts.

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtle grain or parchment paper texture overlay applied globally with mix-blend-multiply.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diya-glow shadows: soft, warm orange/gold tinted shadows (e.g., `shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.15)]` for light, `shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(255,153,51,0.2)]` for dark).
visual_enhancers.borders: Gold hairline dividers (1px solid border-t or border-b using #D4AF37 with 30-50% opacity).
visual_enhancers.motifs: Kolam patterns, mandala geometry, Om symbols embedded subtly in backgrounds, empty states, or card corners with low opacity (5-10%).
visual_enhancers.shapes: Arch shapes (like temple doors) for deity cards, rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for standard cards.

deity_cards.style: Soft glow behind image, arch-shaped tops (or rounded-t-full), bordered in thin gold, containing Sanskrit (Devanagari) + English names.
deity_cards.hover: Slight upward translation (-translate-y-1), intensify the diya-glow shadow, smooth transition.
deity_cards.content: Image, Name (Sanskrit + English), small icon indicating Ashtottara/Sahasranama availability.

persistent_audio_player.style: Fixed bottom bar (fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50), glassmorphism over sandalwood/indigo background (backdrop-blur-xl). Thin gold top border.
persistent_audio_player.elements: Pulsing OM indicator (animated text or SVG), track name (Sanskrit/English), mute/play toggle icon, chant switcher dropdown, decorative waveform visualization.
persistent_audio_player.interaction: Replaces continuous background OM chant when a specific sloka/song is tapped. Global switchable background chant.

panchangam_calendar.style: Traditional almanac look. Grid layout with daily data (Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, Karana, Vara, Sunrise/Sunset).
panchangam_calendar.festival_column: Side column on desktop, stacked on mobile. Contains story, significance, pooja vidhi, slokas with parchment background.

dinacharya_timeline.style: Vertical timeline with circular node points (gold border, saffron fill) representing daily rituals (Wake up, Bhumi Vandanam, Snana, etc.).
dinacharya_timeline.interaction: Clicking a node expands an accordion or card with the specific sloka (Sanskrit + transliteration + meaning) and an inline audio play button.

language_switcher.style: Top right elegant dropdown or toggle (e.g., EN | SA | TE | HI | TA). Used to switch transliteration and meanings globally.

layouts.mobile: Mobile-first approach. Fixed persistent audio player at bottom (add padding-bottom to body to prevent overlap). Stacked sections (Panchangam -> Dinacharya -> Deities).
layouts.desktop: Asymmetric layout. Left sidebar for Navigation, Panchangam & timeline, right larger masonry or grid area for Deity library and detailed reading.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8 to give elements breathing room.

micro_animations: Diya flicker: slow pulse animation on opacity of warm drop-shadows or a tiny flame SVG.
Chant pulse: gentle scaling/breathing animation (scale 1 to 1.05) of the OM symbol in the audio player.
Staggered reveals: Framer motion staggered entry for timeline items and deity cards on scroll/load.

hero_background.description: Hindu temple architecture for top header/hero backgrounds

diya.description: Lit diya oil lamp for ritual/festival sections

deity_placeholder.description: Golden Ganesha statue for Deity library placeholders

temple_architecture.description: Intricate temple tower for background/ambient sections

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a toggle for Light (Sandalwood/Gold) and Dark (Indigo Night Sky) modes. Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='play-chant-button'). Avoid default Vercel/Stripe looks. Do not use generic fonts like Inter. Use Shadcn components for UI logic but heavily customize their styling to remove standard borders and add the specified diya-glow shadows and gold hairline borders. Implement Language switcher and audio play logic conditionally mocking the actual audio elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize optical alignment over strict mathematical alignment.
Do not center-align paragraph text; keep reading text left-aligned.
Add generous padding (p-6, p-8) to container elements.
Ensure minimum WCAG AA contrast ratios, especially for gold/orange text on cream.
Never use purely transparent overlays; add a slight blur (backdrop-blur-md) or tint.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on their role.
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic by avoiding uniform borders, generic gradients, and standard system fonts.

accessibility.focus_states: High contrast ring using Deep Saffron or Gold (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF9933]`).
accessibility.contrast: Text over textured backgrounds must be fully legible, use drop shadows if necessary.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for pulsing OM and diya flickers.

3d_libraries_and_media.instructions: 3D libraries not strictly required, focus on high-fidelity 2D UI with depth via shadows. Use SVG icons for mandalas and Om symbols. Audio playback can be visually simulated.
